desc: soft-edged luma key laying feedback into a brightness band

params.name: luma
params.help: centre brightness of the band that gets replaced with feedback

params.name: range
params.help: width of the keyed band — 0 keys nothing, full width swallows half the tonal range

params.name: edge
params.help: softness at the band's edges — 0 is a hard cut, high values fade in and out
